entities.name: Molimo
entities.description: Maro-Sorcerer of Llanowar, a reserved elf soul of the forest who despised strangers and did not recognize Gaea's authority.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A being who journeyed to Llanowar to find Eladamri and pointed out Freyalise was a simple planeswalker.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: A refugee leader given the power of the forest by Molimo.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Given a hull seed by Molimo to rebuild the Skyship Weatherlight.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker Molimo believed was the true goddess of nature.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The goddess whose authority Molimo did not recognize.

entities.name: Skyship Weatherlight
entities.description: The airship rebuilt with a hull seed from Molimo.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion before which Molimo was already active.

events.summary: Molimo reluctantly helps Multani when he comes to Llanowar to find Eladamri, giving both the power of the forest.
Centuries later Molimo provides Jhoira with a hull seed to rebuild the Skyship Weatherlight.
events.quote: provide Jhoira with a hull seed

relations.note: He gave her a hull seed.
relations.quote: provide Jhoira with a hull seed
